title: Constructible models for duals of locally constant perfect complexes
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and let $S$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be one of the admissible condensed coefficient rings $A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, where $A$ is finite commutative and killed by a power of $\ell$ and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Put $R=\Lambda(*)$ and $B=\Lambda_S$. Use the pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], scalar perfect complexes [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex, def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package], and the relative unbounded derived tensor and internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Suppose $P\in D(B)$ has a pro-étale cover $\{U_i\to S\}$ and bounded complexes $F_i^\bullet$ of finite projective $R$-modules such that $P|_{U_i}\simeq B|_{U_i}\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{F_i^\bullet}$, with termwise tensor and constant sheaves denoted by underlines. Set $P^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_B(P,B)$ and $F_i^{\vee,\bullet}=\operatorname{Hom}_R^\bullet(F_i^\bullet,R[0])$. For every integer $q$ there are isomorphisms
$$H^q(P)|_{U_i}\cong B|_{U_i}\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{H^q(F_i^\bullet)},\qquad H^q(P^\vee)|_{U_i}\cong B|_{U_i}\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{H^q(F_i^{\vee,\bullet})}.$$
The scalar cohomology modules in these formulas are finitely presented. Both $P$ and $P^\vee$ have bounded cohomology and belong to $\Dbc(S,\Lambda)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. The assertion includes the completed integral coefficient sheaf $\mathcal O_{E,S}\cong\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\pi_E^n)_S$ [det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit, lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction].

proof.text: The finite-projective dual lemma makes $F_i^\vee$ bounded finite projective. For $G=F_i,F_i^\vee$, finite kernels give finite $Z^q(G)$; the cokernel of $G^{q-1}\to Z^q(G)$ is finite $H^q(G)$. Noetherian finite-module presentation makes both cohomology modules finitely presented.

Derived internal Hom restriction gives $P^\vee|_{U_i}=R\mathcal Hom_{B|_{U_i}}(C_{U_i}F_i,B|_{U_i})$. Apply scalar-perfect dual realization to obtain $P^\vee|_{U_i}\simeq C_{U_i}(F_i^\vee)$, with its signed differential.

Exact realization and exact slice restriction commute with homology. Applied to the given model and Step 3, this yields $H^q(P)|_{U_i}\cong C_{U_i}(H^qF_i)$ and $H^q(P^\vee)|_{U_i}\cong C_{U_i}(H^qF_i^\vee)$ on every ORIGINAL cover member. Step 2 supplies finite presentation.

A field is Noetherian since its ideals are $0,(1)$. Finite type over it makes $S$ Noetherian and quasi-compact; local Noetherianity makes it quasi-separated. Choose a finite affine open cover and apply finite affine pro-etale refinement, obtaining finitely many $V_j$ factoring through original $U_{i(j)}$. Coefficient localization and exact slice restriction carry both models to these charts, with the same scalar maps. If $S$ is empty use the zero complexes and bound $[0,0]$. Otherwise choose supports $[a_j,b_j]$ for $F_{i(j)}$, put $a=\min a_j$, $b=\max b_j$, and use $[-b,-a]$ for the duals. Apply local-model cohomology descent to each complex: Step 1 gives exactness and Step 2 finite presentation. It gives global boundedness and constructibility on the single stratum $S$, hence both $\Dbc$ memberships.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q94-16e5505c4 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Re-split check against the base (NS snapshot of this item): the statement is byte-identical and all ten base steps are carried. The two new nodes are of comparable size, and neither restates the item. Node A is true. R is Noetherian: finite ring, DVRs, fields, with Q̄ℓ=C(*,Q̄ℓ). Exactness holds case by case: for finite A the sheaf is constant (Stacks 093J); for fields split sequences are preserved by an additive functor; for O_E/Zℓ, B_T≅lim R/πⁿ (det-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x-integral-limit(3)) is flat (Stacks 093M, lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction); slices follow from exact restriction. Edge cases A=0, A=Z/ℓ² and empty T are fine. Node B is true. E^q is a summand of B^N, so Hom(E^q,−) is exact, and the K-injective comparison is a quasi-iso by induction over stupid truncations. β_V is an iso in the free case and passes to retracts. The sign −(−1)^q φ d_F^{−q−1} matches def-pur-hom-complex, and no flatness of B is used. Every item step was checked against the statements it cites. Descent hypotheses are met: quasi-compact S, finite refinement from the Noetherian and quasi-separated S, common interval, exactness on V_j from node A, f.p. from Step 2. The empty S is handled separately. The swap sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients → lem-sfb-coefficient-sections-localization is a correct repair: the cartesian node's Q̄ℓ is the finite-subextension ring, not the item's C(−,Q̄ℓ). lean.statement: theorem internalHomDual_constructible_models (l p : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (hpl : p ≠ l) (S : Scheme.{u}) [S.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (S ↘ Spec (.of k))] : (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A], (∃ n : ℕ, (l : A) ^ n = 0) → Assertion A (finiteCoefficients A) (finiteModel A) S) ∧ Assertion (ULift.{u} ℤ_[l]) (baseIntegralCoefficients l) (baseIntegralModel l) S ∧ (∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E], Assertion (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (FiniteConstantModel.integralCoefficients l E) (FiniteConstantModel.integralModel l E) S) ∧ Assertion (ULift.{u} ℚ_[l]) (baseRationalCoefficients l) (baseRationalModel l) S ∧ (∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E], Assertion E (FiniteConstantModel.rationalCoefficients l E) (FiniteConstantModel.rationalModel l E) S) ∧ Assertion (ULift.{u} (PadicAlgCl l)) (algebraicCoefficients l) (algebraicModel l) S
lean.note: Six explicit coefficient cases of the single local-model assertion: finite discrete A, Z_l, O_E, Q_l, E, and Qbar_l. Ordinary scalar realization reuses FiniteConstantModelResolution. Maintainer review fix: the Qbar_l case is the continuous condensed ring C(-,Qbar_l) for the l-adic norm topology (sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring; the coefficient convention of sk-def-localizing-closure, IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient), realized by the same canonical modelFunctor as the other cases, replacing the delivered finite-subextension colimit object padicAlgClRingObj. The ordinary signed scalar dual is given by real degreewise data. ULift on the three Type-0 base rings only transports scalar coordinates to the scheme universe; all scalar module objects live in Type (u+1). No assumptions of scalar exactness, dualizability or constructibility are added.
